channel.title: HVLS 360 Industry Intelligence
channel.description: HVLS fan news, technical analysis and industrial ventilation intelligence.

item.title: 5 Things We Check on Every Annual HVLS Service
item.description: The five things Big Fan Guys crews check on every yearly HVLS fan service: mount and hardware, safety cables, gearbox and motor, airfoils, controls.

item.title: Your Fans Aren't Just for Summer: Winter Destratification
item.description: Heated air stacks up at the ceiling of tall buildings. Running HVLS fans slow in winter pushes it back down to the floor where people work.

item.title: Why One Big Fan Beats a Wall of Small Ones
item.description: Why facilities swap rows of loud high-speed drum fans for one HVLS fan: wider coverage, even comfort, less noise and clear columns.

item.title: Invertek's Optidrive E4: What the New General-Purpose Drive Is Built For
item.description: What Invertek built the Optidrive E4 for, how you set one up without a display, and what changed from the E3 for HVAC, fan and pump work.

item.title: HVLS Fans Under Sprinklers: Placement, Clearance and the Fire Alarm Interlock
item.description: NFPA 13 placement and clearance rules for HVLS fans, the FM fire tests behind the shutdown rule, and how two manufacturers wire the fire alarm relay.

item.title: Inside the 72-Inch TAZ: A Field Guide to VividAir's Aisle Fan
item.description: Review VividAir TAZ aisle-fan placement, manufacturer performance claims and the guide-label inconsistency to resolve against the installed equipment.

item.title: VividAir and Go Fan Yourself: The Z-Tech, TAZ and Controls Questions Installers Should Ask
item.description: Identify VividAir and legacy Go Fan Yourself product generations, controls and documentation before assuming a fan, drive or keypad is interchangeable.

item.title: Before the First Blade Goes Up: Scissor Lift Planning for HVLS Installations
item.description: Plan HVLS installation access around lift capacity, work position, travel routes and site hazards before committing equipment and labor to the job.

item.title: Powerfoil 6: What the Installation Manual Tells Field Crews
item.description: Review Powerfoil 6 installation planning through its manufacturer manual: electrical variant, structural attachment, controls and shutdown coordination.

item.title: HVLS Fans, Air Movement and Ventilation: What Facility Managers Need to Know
item.description: Understand how HVLS air movement differs from outdoor-air ventilation, with practical questions for facility specifications and project reviews.

item.title: Greenheck's Redesigned DS-3 and DS-6: What Changes on an HVLS Job
item.description: Examine Greenheck DS fan documentation, shipping-date manual differences and controls questions that affect installation planning and submittal review.

item.title: CFEI vs. CFM per Watt: How to Read an HVLS Fan Efficiency Claim
item.description: Compare CFEI and CFM per watt, identify the operating points behind fan ratings, and separate laboratory efficiency evidence from installed performance.

item.title: ABB's 2026 Outdoor-Rated Drive Expansion: What Fan Installers Should Actually Check
item.description: Review ABB enclosure and drive-configuration claims, environmental limits and the OEM compatibility questions to settle before quoting an HVLS retrofit.
